tts_summary: Hey there! Thor, as a rescue puppy at 10 months, is in that lively adolescent phase, and you’re likely seeing his puppy spunk turn into focused curiosity. Pitbulls are loyal, food-motivated, and built for power, so you know how his play sessions and chewing can be intense. Puppies around this age typically finish big growth spurts, keep teething behaviors, and need steady socialization and consistent training as fear periods can pop up. Day-to-day you’re juggling housetraining, strong-leash moments, and joyful bonding in a big yard—plus this heat makes cooling and hydration extra important. Here’s the thing: the plan below pairs high-protein food, training minis, durable chews and cooling gear to match Thor’s needs. Take a look at the recommendations below.
